settings.title: Ingredients
settings.text:
KEY ingredients

Resveratrol-enriched yeast, nicotinamide riboside chloride, White Versailles currant fruit extract, rice seed extract (contains ceramide), botanical blend (blood orange fruit extract, spinach leaf juice powder, grape seed extract, red wine powder)

ADDITIONAL INGREDIENTS

Water, apple juice concentrate, grape juice concentrate, glycerin, purple carrot juice concentrate, xanthan gum, citric acid, sunflower lecithin, gum acacia, steviol glycosides, pectin

Learn more about the active ingredients.

settings.title: How to use
settings.text:
HOW to use

Drink two shots shot per week—either straight from the bottle or over ice with sparkling water. Enjoy with or without food. Shake well before drinking.

STORAGE

Store at room temperature and away from direct sunlight to preserve potency. Consume within 18 months.

A QUICK NOTE

We recommend consulting your healthcare provider before adding any supplements to your routine, particularly if you have any health conditions or are taking medications.
